name: Tung oil
description: Tung oil (CAS 8001-20-5 ), also traded as China wood oil, is a fast-drying, highly cross-linkable drying oil pressed from the seeds of the Vernicia fordii tree. It polymerizes on exposure to air to form a hard, water-resistant film. This unique chemical property makes it a preferred binder and curing agent across protective coating and industrial finishing systems. In architectural and industrial coatings, it functions as a film-forming binder that delivers moisture resistance. It provides exceptional surface hardness in wood finishes, deck sealers, and marine varnishes. Adhesive and sealant formulators incorporate it as a reactive component to improve flexibility and bonding durability in oil-based systems. In printing inks, particularly lithographic and letterpress formulations, it controls rheology and sets speed. It also contributes significantly to rub resistance on the final print, ensuring a high-quality and durable finish for various substrates. Rubber compounders use this oil as a processing and surface modification agent to improve compatibility. It enhances finished surface characteristics and is supplied as an amber-colored liquid in drum and IBC quantities for industrial use. Bulk tanker options are available for high-volume buyers requiring consistent supply chains. Standard commercial grades include raw and heat-bodied variants, which are differentiated by their specific viscosity and drying performance during application. Technical-grade is the predominant specification in industrial markets, though refined grades are available for specialty coating applications.
